description: Illustrative SportHub arena with badminton courts, an adjacent basketball court, timber flooring, roof trusses and glazing. Not a photograph or an accurate model of a real facility.
camera: Seamless periodic dolly and lateral orbit
quality: Procedural oak grain and staggered plank joints, rubber bump/roughness, physical clearcoat surfaces, PMREM room reflections, 4096px directional shadows and soft contact shadows. Rendered at 1.25 pixel ratio before downsampling, higher-quality encoding.
runtime: Native video plus CSS scroll animations and pointer parallax. Three.js is used only to generate media. No third-party stock media or runtime CDN requests.
